ar.#A route I know, but not my usual one: مسار أعرفه، لكنه ليس مساري المعتاد
ar.#My usual route, but I had to change it: طريقي المعتاد، لكن اضطررت إلى تغييره أثناء الطريق (مثل أعمال طرق أو شارع مغلق)

de.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Eine Route, die ich kenne, aber nicht meine übliche
de.#My usual route, but I had to change it: Mein üblicher Weg, aber ich musste ihn unterwegs ändern (z. B. Baustelle, gesperrte Straße)

fa.#A route I know, but not my usual one: مسیری که می‌شناسم، اما مسیر همیشگی‌ام نیست
fa.#My usual route, but I had to change it: مسیر همیشگی‌ام، اما مجبور شدم در راه آن را تغییر دهم (مثلاً به‌خاطر کارهای عمرانی یا خیابان بسته)

fr.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Un itinéraire que je connais, mais pas mon itinéraire habituel
fr.#My usual route, but I had to change it: Mon trajet habituel, mais j’ai dû le modifier en chemin (par ex. travaux, rue fermée)

hu.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Egy ismert, de nem a szokásos útvonalam
hu.#My usual route, but I had to change it: A szokásos útvonalam, de útközben változtatnom kellett rajta (pl. útépítés, lezárt utca miatt)

it.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Un percorso che conosco, ma non quello abituale
it.#My usual route, but I had to change it: Il mio percorso abituale, ma ho dovuto cambiarlo strada facendo (ad es. lavori, una strada chiusa)

tr.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Bildiğim ama her zamanki olmayan bir güzergâh
tr.#My usual route, but I had to change it: Her zamanki yolum, ama yolda değiştirmek zorunda kaldım (örn. yol çalışması, kapalı bir sokak)
